items.title: Nvidia and Jensen Huang face shareholder lawsuit alleging investors were misled about spy affair
items.summary: A shareholder has sued Nvidia and its CEO, Jensen Huang, accusing them of deceiving investors in their responses to media reports about Huang's affair with a purported Chinese spy that threatens national security. The complaint comes after President Donald Trump said the FBI is investigating the affair, which Huang has acknowledged to and apologized for.

items.title: Jensen Huang's spy scandal may cost Nvidia the China chip fight it was winning
items.summary: Jensen Huang's spy scandal could revive Washington's push to ban China from US chips.

items.title: 3 bipartisan plans could slap new controls on semiconductor exports. Elizabeth Warren wants to pass one this year.
items.summary: Three bipartisan measures circulating on Capitol Hill could reshape US export controls on semiconductors. On Monday, Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren announced an effort to implement one in the coming weeks.

items.title: Microsoft pushes Trump to halt Chinese data center component ban: Reuters
items.summary: Investing.com -- Microsoft has been lobbying the Trump administration to abandon plans to bar imports of Chinese optical transceivers, a key component in AI data centers, Reuters reported on Tuesday, citing three people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Soleo Health Selected as a Specialty Pharmacy Partner for Pasatru™, a New Treatment in Adults with Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva
items.summary: FRISCO, Texas, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Soleo Health, an innovative leader and national provider of complex specialty pharmacy services, announced today that it was selected as a specialty pharmacy partner for Pasatru™ (garetosmab-grts), Regeneron’s FDA-approved product to reduce formation of new heterotopic ossification (HO) lesions and clinician-assessed flare-ups in adults with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP), an ultra-rare genetic disorder.
